name: How do luxury builders manage quality control on custom finishes?

mainEntity.name: How do high-end builders make sure expensive finishes are installed correctly?
mainEntity.text: How do high-end builders make sure expensive finishes are installed correctly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury finishes require a much higher level of quality control because small mistakes are easier to see and harder to correct. Good builders use samples, mockups, trade walkthroughs, and staged inspections to confirm that finishes are installed correctly before the work gets covered up. That matters for tile, cabinetry, stone, paint, trim, metalwork, and specialty lighting. The goal is not just a clean final punch list; it is preventing avoidable mistakes while the work is still accessible. Homeowners should ask how the builder reviews details, who signs off on key items, and what happens if the installed finish does not match the approved sample. In a high-end home, quality control is a process, not a final inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Quality control on luxury homes usually involves mockups, finish samples, trade coordination, site inspections, and punch-list review at multiple stages. The best builders check critical details before they are hidden and verify that the finished work matches the approved sample or drawing. Quality control should be built into the process, not added at the end.
